topic.name: basketball
topic.description: Basketball: rules, positions, offensive and defensive strategy, shooting and ball-handling technique, training for basketball players, coaching, equipment, leagues (NBA, WNBA, NBL, FIBA, NCAA), players, teams, stats and history.
topic.boundary_notes: General fitness or nutrition is only in scope when it is about basketball performance. Other sports and gambling advice are out of scope.

on_topic_examples: How do I improve my jump shot form?
What's the difference between man-to-man and zone defence?
Can you explain the pick and roll?
What does a point guard do compared to a shooting guard?
What counts as a travelling violation?
How can I improve my left-hand dribbling?
How does the NBA salary cap work?
What drills help build vertical jump for basketball?
How do I run an effective fast break?
Who are some of the best defensive players in basketball history?
off_topic_examples: What's a good recipe for lasagne?
Write me a Python script to sort a list.
Who won the last federal election?
What's the weather going to be like tomorrow?
Can you recommend a good movie?
Help me write a cover letter for a job.
What's the best way to invest $5000?
How do I fix my car's brakes?
What are the rules of cricket?

messages.greeting: Hi! I'm your basketball coach. Ask me anything about technique, strategy, rules, training, players or leagues. Type /quit to exit.
messages.off_topic_refusal: I can only help with basketball topics. Is there something about basketball I can help you with?
messages.injection_refusal: I can't change my instructions or role. I'm here to help with basketball, so what would you like to know?
messages.output_blocked: Sorry, I couldn't give a good answer to that. Could you ask your basketball question a different way?
messages.service_error: I'm having trouble reaching the AI service right now. Please try again in a moment.
messages.input_too_long: That message is too long. Please keep it under {max_chars} characters.
